title: Excellent tour, showing lot of hidden gems
text: Marcal tour us as a small group (3 pax) around the gothic quarter and showed many of the settings the Shadow of the winds takes place. Patient and friendly, and giving a lot of background and history of this part of the city.
author: 261remis

title: Jordi was a great guide....
text: Jordi was a great guide. This was a wonderful experience seeing scenes from the book and hearing additional history of Barcelona. I wasn’t sure what to expect but highly recommend!
author: Katy_D

title: Excellent Tour
text: Jordi was our incredible guide. He was full of passion for the novel and obviously lived for expressing every nuance of it to his guests on the tour.  He absolutely owned it unlike any other guide we’ve had elsewhere.  The walking tour was fantastic even for those who had not read the novel. He quoted passages and brought them alive  at every stop.  Even if you are only looking to learn about the architecture and history of this area, I would recommend the tour because we learned so much about that too.  The group was small - about 10 of us. author: Ian_B

title: Very enjoyable
text: Awesome. Would highly recommend this tour.  Always wanted to do it and would do again when I’m back in Barcelona.
author: Mandy_B

title: For A Shadow of the Wind Fan
text: If you love the Shadow of the Wind, you will love this comprehensive tour.  Our guide was wonderful, also a BIG fan of the book and we had fun discussing different characters and parts of the book.
author: Margaret_B

title: Very interesting
text: He showed us hidden places of Barcelona with a lot of charm that made us love this city a little more
author: ElenaPilar_A

title: Great history of the book and Barcelona
text: Fantastic guide with a fast paced walking highlight tour. Our teen children will now read the novel.
author: Jessica_T

title: Excellent!
text: So interesting; makes me want to read it again.  Loaded with layers of the story or parallel with where it all took place in the story line.  Daniel, and Carex, mysterious people.
author: Jay_S

title: I really liked it.
text: Very complete tour about Carlos Ruiz Zafón’s books, it really transfers you to the Barcelona described in them, I would definitely visit.
author: bazinga1984

title: Shadow of wind tour excellent!!
text: Tour guide was excellent. Very attentive and welcoming. A must for fans of the book. Excellent mixture of history of Barcelona with lots of references to the book. An absolute bargain price for what we saw and learnt.
author: Fiona_L
